# The Leadership Forge

> Practical AI professional development for K-12 leaders navigating AI transformation. Built by a practicing K-12 Director of Technology.

The Leadership Forge helps district leaders build the tools, frameworks, and 3-year roadmap they need to lead AI adoption — without academic theory or vendor pitches. Courses ladder from AI Foundations through an Equity Audit into Fluency, Strategy, and Action tracks.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of the program, the three course "doors", and the pathway from Foundations to Action.
- [Courses](/courses): Catalog of professional development courses for K-12 leaders.
- [Sign in](/auth): Sign in or create an account.
